name: lw_28724
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a * b + b * c + c * a = 1) : Real.sqrt (a^2 + 1 / (b * c)) + Real.sqrt (b^2 + 1 / (c * a)) + Real.sqrt (c^2 + 1 / (a * b)) ≥ Real.sqrt 30
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a * b + b * c + c * a = 1), Real.sqrt (a^2 + 1 / (b * c)) + Real.sqrt (b^2 + 1 / (c * a)) + Real.sqrt (c^2 + 1 / (a * b)) ≥ Real.sqrt 30
informal: Let a,b,c >0 and $ ab + bc + ca = 1$ . Prove that:\n$ \sqrt {a^2 + \frac{1}{{bc}}} + \sqrt {b^2 + \frac{1}{{ca}}} + \sqrt {c^2 + \frac{1}{{ab}}} \ge \sqrt {30}$
